title: Usa el Modo de Edición Inteligente de Dreamina con Seedance 2.5 para…
content:
Usa el Modo de Edición Inteligente de Dreamina con Seedance 2.5 para seleccionar hasta 5 momentos del video y, en cada uno, marcar hasta 5 áreas específicas para cambiar color/material/oferta/fondo manteniendo el resto del clip igual y así crear múltiples versiones sin regenerar desde cero.  
Aprovecha la generación ultralarga de Dreamina (hasta 3 minutos) para desarrollar una misma idea creativa de principio a fin (explicativo, lanzamiento o historia de marca) sin cambiar de herramienta.  
Si ya diseñaste la escena en Blender o Maya, usa el plugin de Dreamina para mantener esa composición directamente en el render final con Seedance.

en.content:
Use Dreamina’s Smart Editing Mode with Seedance 2.5 to select up to 5 moments in a video and, within each one, mark up to 5 specific areas to change the color/material/offer/background while keeping the rest of the clip the same, so you can create multiple versions without regenerating from scratch.  
Take advantage of Dreamina’s ultra-long generation (up to 3 minutes) to develop a single creative idea from start to finish (explainer, launch, or brand story) without switching tools.  
If you already designed the scene in Blender or Maya, use Dreamina’s plugin to preserve that composition directly in the final render with Seedance.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] This is what really makes Dreamina the best platform for using Seedance 2.5.

Smart Editing Mode: you can select up to 5 moments in the video and, within each one, mark up to 5 specific areas.

Change a color, a material, an offer, or the background, while the rest of the clip stays exactly the same.

One generation, multiple final versions.

[Thread 2] The other major advantage: ultra-long generation of up to 3 minutes.

While many platforms only allow a few seconds of usable content, Dreamina lets you develop a single creative idea from start to finish: an explainer video, a launch, or a complete brand story, without having to switch tools halfway through the process.

And if you already designed the scene in Blender or Maya, the plugin keeps that composition directly in the final render.

[Thread 3] With a single subscription, you get unlimited access to the entire Seedance model family, with lower prices than other platforms that use the same models. They will even match the price if necessary.

• Seedance 2.5 from approximately USD 0.097 per second, with 40% off on the annual plan and an additional 32%.
